Armani Gray Marble is the definition of refined contrast. With its luxurious dark background and clean, linear veining, it embodies modern elegance. This marble is particularly popular in boutique hotels, upscale apartments, luxury retail stores, and architect-designed residences.

The visual intensity of Armani Gray makes it ideal for feature walls or large open spaces, where its veining and tone can shine without being overly busy. When used in slab form, especially with bookmatching techniques, the stone creates a bold, artistic effect.

This marble offers excellent durability and workability. It's easy to cut, shape, and polish, and holds up well with regular maintenance and sealing.

body:
Filled Travertine is a refined natural stone that has earned its place in both traditional and contemporary architecture. Known for its earthy charm and soft tonal range — from creamy beige to warm taupe — this stone is processed through a filling technique where the natural holes and pores typical of travertine are sealed with resin or cement. The result is a smooth, clean surface that retains the rustic beauty of the stone while offering a more practical and uniform finish.

✅ Aesthetic Appeal & Versatility

One of the defining features of Filled Travertine is its timeless appearance. The filled finish creates a balanced and elegant look, perfect for flooring, wall cladding, bathroom vanities, fireplace surrounds, and indoor stairs. Its subtle veining and warm tones blend well with a wide variety of materials such as wood, concrete, brass, and glass.

This stone fits beautifully into luxury homes, boutique hotels, offices, and high-end retail environments — offering a blend of nature and sophistication.

🛠️ Durability & Performance

Filled Travertine isn’t just about looks — it performs. Once filled and honed or polished, it becomes:

  • Less porous and more resistant to stains and moisture

  • Easier to clean and maintain than unfilled travertine

  • Resistant to surface chipping, ideal for interior high-traffic zones

Though it is not recommended for freeze-thaw environments or heavy-duty exterior use, its strength, when used indoors, meets or exceeds design expectations.

Imperial Marble is a breathtaking natural stone defined by its dynamic and complex aesthetic. Featuring a warm, luminous cream background, this striking marble is uniquely characterized by its dramatic, chaotic veining in shades of rich beige, earthy brown, and delicate white. This unpredictable, sweeping network of veins ensures that no two slabs are exactly alike, creating highly unique, expressive focal points for luxury architectural projects.

It is particularly appreciated in:

  • Statement interior flooring and grand entranceways

  • Breathtaking interior wall cladding and continuous feature walls

  • Striking kitchen countertops, island waterfalls, and backsplashes

  • Dramatic bathroom vanities, walls, and wet rooms

Due to its robust structure and dynamic visual appeal, Imperial Marble thrives in high-end residential and commercial spaces. When polished to a high gloss, its intricate veining pops against the cream base, adding immense depth, movement, and energy to the room. It can also be honed for a softer, more muted elegance.

Its warm cream base and energetic earth-toned veins pair exquisitely with dark cabinetry, rich woods, and brass or bronze architectural hardware, beautifully blending classic luxury with organic natural artistry.

body:
Red Travertine is a unique and visually striking natural stone that brings warmth and sophistication to any space. Quarried primarily in Iran and Turkey, this stunning stone features rich red and burgundy hues, often accented by natural veins and textures. Its elegant appearance and durability make it a popular choice for flooring, walls, countertops, and decorative applications.

Key Features:

  • Exquisite Aesthetic: The deep red and earthy tones create a luxurious and inviting atmosphere.

  • Versatile Applications: Suitable for both indoor and outdoor projects, including flooring, walls, facades, and countertops.

  • Durability & Longevity: With proper care, Red Travertine maintains its beauty and strength for decades.

  • Natural Variation: Each slab showcases unique patterns, ensuring a one-of-a-kind installation.

  • Eco-Friendly Choice: As a naturally occurring stone, it is an environmentally responsible building material.

Common Applications:

  • Interior Design: Perfect for elegant flooring, kitchen backsplashes, bathroom walls, and countertops.

  • Exterior Use: Popular for garden pathways, pool surrounds, and building facades.

  • Decorative Elements: Used in sculptures, tabletops, and statement pieces in luxury spaces.

Finishing Options:

Red Travertine is available in various finishes, allowing customization based on design preferences:

  • Polished: Enhances the stone’s vibrant colors and provides a glossy, reflective surface.

  • Honed: Offers a matte, smooth finish for a contemporary and understated look.

  • Brushed & Tumbled: Provides a rustic, aged appearance, perfect for classic and vintage designs.

  • Filled & Unfilled: Filling enhances smoothness, while unfilled maintains a natural, rugged texture.

Maintenance & Care:

To ensure the longevity of Red Travertine, follow these care tips:

  • Sealing: Apply a high-quality sealant to protect against stains and moisture.

  • Cleaning: Use a pH-neutral stone cleaner to prevent surface damage.
